subject: Nadia Ross — interviewer anchors, backups, and debrief plan
messages:
From: Natalie O'Connor <natalie@talentbridge.com>
To: markus_klein, monica_patel
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Nadia Ross — available windows and resume

Hi Markus / Monica,

Quick intro: Nadia Ross (resume attached) — ex-Stripe infra PM, currently interviewing for Senior Product Manager (Inference) at Redwood. She's available next week windows below for a 4-slot onsite (remote):
- Tue 2027-04-13: 10:00–13:00 PT
- Wed 2027-04-14: 12:00–16:00 PT

We're trying to lock an interviewer slate: system design (60m), product sense (45m), execution/case (45m), culture/manager (30m). Can you confirm who can anchor each panel and any preferred backups? Also copying Nadia on scheduling logistics (Nadia — do any of those windows work?).

Attachments: Nadia_Ross_Resume.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

—Natalie
TalentBridge (recruiting partner)
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop, monica_patel
Cc: Natalie O'Connor <natalie@talentbridge.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nadia Ross — available windows and resume

Thanks Natalie — forwarding to the core interview pool. Nadia looks promising on the resume. Quick proposed plan:

- Anchor roles:
  - System design (60m) — Monica (anchor)
  - Product sense (45m) — Lauren (anchor)
  - Execution/case (45m) — I can take or we can use senior PM bench
  - Culture/manager (30m) — Grace (backup)

Notes / asks:
- Monica / Lauren: if either of you have slot conflicts, please propose a direct backfill (someone who has done PM inference interviews recently). We should avoid rotating a new interviewer into the anchor role at the last minute.
- I want a single doc with 1–2 bullet calibration points per interviewer (what to probe, red flags) — I'll draft a candidate briefing and share.

If you can reply with availability for Tue/Wed windows above, I'll confirm with Natalie and send calendar invites with the briefing attached.

Markus
Director, Product (Inference)
Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein
Cc: monica_patel
Date: 2027-04-11T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nadia Ross — available windows and resume

Markus — I can take product sense on Tue 4/13 at 10:45 PT or Wed 4/14 at 13:00 PT. If you want me to anchor, I can prepare 3 micro-scenarios (hot path tradeoffs, roadmap prioritization, instrumentation asks).

If Lauren anchors 4/13, who will cover execution/case? I can push my prep earlier if needed.

Thanks — Lauren
Senior PM, Recommendations
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein, lauren_bishop
Date: 2027-04-11T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nadia Ross — available windows and resume

I can anchor system design on Tue 4/13 at 11:30 PT. I'm out most of Wed afternoon. For execution/case backfill: recommend pulling in Grace O'Connor as the primary backup (she's done several case interviews with infra PMs) — tagging her below. Grace, can you take 4/13 at 12:30 PT if Markus takes the execution slot earlier?

Also — small operational ask: can we use the standby pool approach (rotate a second interviewer who can step in with <24h notice)? If so, I'll reach out to the pool and propose 2 names.

Monica
Staff PM, Systems
From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein, monica_patel, lauren_bishop
Cc: Natalie O'Connor <natalie@talentbridge.com>, Nadia Ross <nadia.ross@example.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nadia Ross — interviewer anchors, backups, and debrief plan

I can take the 4/13 12:30 PT culture/manager slot as backup and will review the candidate briefing. Markus — I'm happy to be the debrief facilitator (15–20 min summary) immediately after the last interviewer. I'll create the debrief doc and a shared Slack thread (#hiring-eng) for live notes.

Markus — please attach the briefing and the final calendar links when you send invites. I'll ping the standby pool for one additional float (likely Ben Carter or Ethan Park) in case of last-minute conflict.

Grace O'Connor
PM, Hiring Panel Reserve
